lines: Aina's sharp kick struck a wing, and Lilim-Muo wavered in mid-air.
Aina dodged Lilim-Muo's attack, but while her face showed a smile of composure, her footing had become quite dangerous.
The same went for me watching over herー
(Aina, when you bounce like that, your chest...! And when you jump like that, your butt...!)
Aina fought Lilim-Muo with only her physical skills. It was amazing, incredible, but...
The sight of her, practically naked and defenseless, the way she fought with her barely-covered body trembling, her breathing ragged, was far too seductive.
(...Er, this isn't the time to be looking at that! I need to back her up, or at least issue commands...)
(But all I can think of are dirty thoughts! So this is the power of the demon qi...!)
And, of course, that influence seemed to have reached Aina as well.
Fuma, yer a Taimanin, ain'tcha?! Can't ya drive 'em back usin' a Ninja Art or somethin'!?
If I could, I would've done it by now! ーSorry, I'm losing it too. Forget about backing you up, I'm practically becoming a burden.
Seriously... If I just had a weapon... no, even just some clothes...!
Regardless of the fact that our opponent was Lilim, there was too much of a difference in armor between her mysterious high-spec robot and our thin swimsuits.
『What's wrong? Is that all you got?』
With a calm expression(?), Lilim-Muo raised its weapon high overhead.
H-Hey, stop, Lilim! Did you forget you owe me for saving you so many times!?
Fine! I lose! Let's put this behind us for 500 yen!
『Okay then, 1,000 yen and a monthly snack tribute!』
『Wahaha! The weaker the dog, the more it barks, huh!』
Hey, Lilim?! What are you doing, negotiating however you please!?
That brat Lilim was getting too carried away, and just when she'd angered the head maid...
No sooner had the door been forcefully opened than Metier had come bursting in.
She then tossed the clothing and weaponry that she'd held in hand to Aina.
Thanks to you two making such a show of breaking in through the front entrance, the security in other areas had become short-handed.
I was able to take advantage of that to grab the clothes from the checkroom and make it in here.
So you mean Aina's recklessness became an unexpected distraction!
They say that sometimes fortune favors the bold. On the other hand, had we been too cautious at that time,
the demon qi would have fully spread through us before we arrived here and we might not have been in any condition to fight.
Aina quickly dressed and readied her guns.
『H-, hmph! So you got dressed, what's the big deal!』
『You must be shaky from the demon qi by now. There's no way you can put up a decent fight...』
Aina had removed her eyepatch, which she hadn't even removed when she was in the swimsuit. From within, her golden right eye shone bewitchingly.
The moment I'd seen that eye, I'd been struck by a strange sensation, as if I were being intensely drawn toward it.
I didn't really wanna use this power, but...
Aina, having said that and taken aim, seemed like a different person from a moment ago.
『The demon qi was purged... No, not purged! It was consumed by something more magically dense!?』
The demon qi disappeared from Aina's body before our eyes.
Both rounds found their marks in each of Lilim-Muo's eyes.
(Unbelievable... So this is the power of a monster hunter.)
Having lost her vision, Lilim had started to reel and rage indiscriminately.
Her scythe smashed through walls, tore furniture into pieces, and even sent the demons flying.
It's okay! I got it now!
Alright! Then let's get outta here, quick!
I urged Aina and Metier to go around the side of Lilim-Muo, and we rushed out of the dining hall.
『Arghhh! How dare yooouuu!! Where'd you go, Fuma!? This is unforgivable!! Fuma!!!』
We escaped outside at full speed, putting the sound of Lilim-Muo's rampaging behind us.
Phew... We should be fine here.
Having escaped the annex building, we'd been taking a short rest on the outskirts of the beach.
The beach had completely taken on the glow of the evening sun, and there were no guests or demons in sight.
Sheesh... There really is nothing good when Lilim is involved.
There's lots of kinds of Succubi and Incubi out there. I learned that much, at least.
Aina had fully recovered, having been freed from the demon qi.
Thanks to the medicine, I was also completely back to normal and regained my composure.
Well, it was a lesson for me, too. Being overly cautious isn't always the play.
Oh, nothing. That aside, Aina, the power of that right eye is...
She'd said she "didn't want to use it," but that eye had been far too powerful.
(And on top of that, that strange sensation, the one I felt when I saw the eye...)
Oh, this? A long time ago, when my parents were killed by monsters... I also kinda...
Aina's eyes grew dark. Whatever the reason was it weighed heavily on her...
Hey you two! Sorry to keep you waiting.
I arranged for a boat to come to port. Please escape from this island before it's too late.
Metier had returned, having made arrangements for our escape.
I'd learned the truth of the disappearances, so I had no more business on this island.
I wanted to get away immediately, head back to Japan, and take a nice long bathー
But will it be okay, you helping us?
Please don’t worry. The head maids who let Lilim run wild are being scolded.
Figures they'd be. That really is a relief.
ーBy the way Metier, what about my clothes?
That's right. Though Aina was wearing clothes, I was still in my swimsuit.
About that... I got them back when I got Aina-san's clothes, but...
They got caught up in Lilim's rampage earlier and were turned to scraps...
I-It's okay! It's summer! You won't catch a cold even if you're half-naked!
Be that as it may, there was no way to do any shopping on this island.
In the end, I escaped from this demon resort via the boat that Metier had prepared wearing only my beach shorts.
And upon returning to the town on the opposite shore where Hebiko and Shikanosuke were waiting, I was laughed at until their sides were fit to burst...
